messages:
samir: @jill_auditor we've got your request for chain-of-custody and the billing spike repro for 2025-11-03. I'm planning the export + repro artifacts below.
jill_auditor: thanks — need a signed manifest, HSM signature proof, exact S3 export paths, and timezone-aware timestamps for all events. auditor will need verification that exports were immutable.
maria_devops: tentative export path: s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/2025-11-03/billing-spike/exp-20251110-01/ . We'll include: manifest.json.sig, logs.tar.gz, har.scrubbed.enc, kms-access-log.csv
kevin_sre: summary of root cause from our initial triage: transient auth 401s from token-service caused a retry storm which led to duplicate entries in billing-aggregator for a ~20m window. We have a playback recipe using replay-tool to reproduce the sequence.
samir: note — HSM export needs a legal/signature step for chain-of-custody. @alice_legal can you confirm the required signature fields? we will use SHA256 for the manifest hash unless you ask otherwise.
alice_legal: SHA256 is fine. We require: manifest hash, signer identity, signed timestamp (UTC), and a PDF chain-of-custody with who handled the files. Upload the signed PDF to the same S3 path and notify auditors.
kevin_sre: reproduction commands (internal) — will provide scrubbed examples. Example playback workflow:
```
# generate scrubbed HAR for window
replay-tool --start 2025-11-03T14:12:00Z --end 2025-11-03T14:40:00Z --filter "status>=500 or status==401" --mask-pii --output /tmp/repro.har
# upload to internal replay cluster
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REPLAY_TOKEN" -X POST https://replay.internal/replay -F file=@/tmp/repro.har
```
kevin_sre: quick repro steps for auditor validation (high level):
1) create a test client with short token TTL (30s)
2) drive ~500 rps for ~3 minutes with loadbot to surface token-service race
3) token-service will return 401 retries for ~30s
4) billing-aggregator dedupe bug causes duplicate billing events when retries correlate
snippets for loadbot:
```
loadbot --concurrency 200 --duration 180s --target https://api.redwood.prod/usage --header "Authorization: Bearer <stale-token>"
```
maria_devops: important: scrubbed HAR will be encrypted with KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-efgh-1234. We will include KMS decrypt logs showing which principals requested decrypts during evidence packaging.
ops-bot: export job queued 2025-11-10T18:05:02Z job-id=exp-20251110-01
replay-bot: replay job accepted, will return a play-id once scrubbed HAR is ingested.
jill_auditor: please confirm object-level immutability proof (ETag, last-modified) and the HSM signature that binds manifest -> file list.
samir: deliverables we'll upload:
- manifest.json (sha256 hashes for each object) + manifest.json.sig (HSM-signed)
- s3_object_list.csv (object, ETag, size, last_modified)
- kms-access-log.csv (key id, principal, timestamp, action)
- har.scrubbed.enc (AES256 encrypted, KMS-wrapped)
- billing-aggregator-metrics.csv (counts, invoice refs)
ETA: EOD tomorrow for initial upload.
jill_auditor: also need the exact compute ids that handled that traffic window (lambda/ecs task ids) to validate chain-of-custody against logs.
kevin_sre: adding compute ids to the export: ecs/redwood-prod/ary-1234, lambda/auth-5678, and host ips enumerated in s3_object_list.csv
maria_devops: once export completes we'll post final S3 locations here. reminder: we will not include raw PII — all HAR entries are scrubbed and replaced with mapping table in a separate encrypted file.
jill_auditor: that mapping table is required for validation but must remain encrypted — auditor will accept encrypted mapping if we provide the decryption steps or temporary decryption key access window.
samir: we will grant auditor temporary KMS decrypt access with explicit principals and time-bound IAM session. details included in kms-access-log.csv and an access-grant.txt in the export.
alice_legal: legal has signed the manifest template. I'll upload chain-of-custody.pdf after the export job finishes and confirm the signer identity fields.
jill_auditor: ok, I'll review once upload completes. final ask: include the playback command lines you used and the exact timestamps where duplicate billing events were observed (UTC).
kevin_sre: will annotate billing-aggregator-metrics.csv with duplicated_event_ids and timestamp ranges: duplicates between 2025-11-03T14:18:10Z -> 2025-11-03T14:37:55Z. We'll point auditors to invoice IDs INV-2025-11-03-44 and INV-2025-11-03-45 for affected customers.
samir: tagging @alice_legal and @kevin_sre — once uploads done I'll ping @jill_auditor. closing loop after upload.
jill_auditor: thanks everyone — expecting the S3 link + signed manifest. aiming to sign-off by end of week after validation.
